objective: Test whether a TRAINED ensemble-disagreement (DEUP-style epistemic uncertainty) gate on the unchanged T1 20-session top-30-of-500 momentum book raises Sharpe (not just cuts drawdown) vs. a same-realized-vol unguarded control, per T-20260928-14 / registry row dir:regime_trust_uncertainty_gate_momentum_ranker, arXiv 2603.13252 'When Alpha Breaks'. Three candidates (U1, U2 book-level exposure cuts; U3 individual-name DEUP-style cap), all counted toward trial exposure (DSR n=3).

parameters.ensemble: k=15 bootstrap LightGBM regressors, row-level bootstrap, seeds 0-14, target = 20-session forward cross-sectional rank of return
parameters.u_i_definition: std across the 15 models' predicted cross-sectional rank for stock i at date t
parameters.book_level_U: mean of u_i(t) over the T1 book's currently-held names, weighted by each name's held weight at t (t known)
parameters.z_definition: U(t)'s quantile within its own trailing 252-session U series, using only U(t) and prior sessions
parameters.settlement_lag_basis: U(t)/z(t) computed from model predictions keyed to trade_date t, itself already point-in-time (features lagged into the label per the walk-forward training contract); applied at the next session's open, i.e. z(s-1) decides the multiplier for session s -- 1-session lag, not the T1 book's own 2-session return-settlement lag, since U/z is not derived from the book's own realized return series.

parameters.ensemble: identical model/ensemble as u1, no re-fitting
identical model/ensemble as u1/u2, no re-fitting
parameters.selection_rule: at each new-cohort formation date, drop candidate names whose u_i(t) is in the top 20% (highest uncertainty) of that day's full top-500-universe u_i distribution, then backfill the cohort to 30 names by momentum rank order among the remaining eligible names
parameters.multiplier_rule: always 1.0 (this candidate changes cohort MEMBERSHIP, not book-level exposure)
parameters.settlement_lag_sessions: n/a (selection uses the same point-in-time model prediction available at cohort formation, per the label contract; no additional settlement lag beyond the base T1 book's own formation-date discipline)
parameters.note: Not applicable to stop condition (a) [AUROC on a drawdown-flag label] per the preregistration -- U3 changes stock selection, not book-level exposure, so it has no book-level z(t) series to score for drawdown-day AUROC; only stop conditions (b) placebo and (c) owner Sharpe rule apply to U3.

data_v1_daily_broad_universe_broad_uncer.source: existing repo feature tables (unchanged) for the T1 book and training features; alpaca SIP daily archive for SPY/SHY/BIL, reused unchanged from run_h20260924_02_momentum_crash_guard.py::load_side_panel

validation_v1_frozen_windows_stage1_stag.stage1_stop_conditions: AUROC<0.60 (U1/U2 only) on a drawdown-flag label over 2024-01-08..latest; placebo (>=200 seeds) beat-fraction/percentile check; owner rule anchor Sharpe vs vol-matched control <0.10 -- ANY one hit stops that candidate at stage 1, refuted, no stage 2
validation_v1_frozen_windows_stage1_stag.stage2_gates: only for a candidate clearing all stage-1 conditions: stress-window >=0.10 Sharpe-vs-matched-control, G1-G5 (G1 anchor CAGR>=50% and max DD<=35%, or G1' anchor Sharpe>=2.0 and CAGR>=30%; G2 holdout Sharpe>=1.0; G3 placebo beat-fraction<=10%; G4 G1-or-G1' holds at 20bp; G5 long-only Alpaca-executable), K1/K2 tiering, DSR at 3 trials
validation_v1_frozen_windows_stage1_stag.sharpe_convention: excess of BIL daily return, ddof=1, sqrt(252) annualization -- reused unchanged from scripts/run_h20260918_05_recent_menu.py::metrics
